name: campusswap-monorepo
description: CampusSwap - College Student Marketplace for Buying, Selling, Renting and Swapping

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.vercel-build: npx prisma@5.19.0 generate --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma && cd backend && npx prisma@5.19.0 generate && cd ../frontend && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
